scope: Only critic regression labels change; actor advantage estimator remains normalized GAE(lambda=.95).
clarification: Default announced and optional question offered; without a different user choice use critic-only ablation matching preceding discussion.

configuration.action_sampling: categorical via independent per-episode NumPy RNG
configuration.value_target: one-step TD: reward + gamma * (1-terminated) * frozen old next-state value
configuration.objective: uniform-transition PPO clipped surrogate; no absolute gamma^t
configuration.actor_initialization: same Policy constructor and torch seed as REINFORCE

value_target.gae: unnormalized GAE advantage + frozen old state value
value_target.one_step_td: one-step TD: reward + gamma * (1-terminated) * frozen old next-state value

pilot.purpose: Timing/execution only; excluded from formal results

stopping_rule: Fixed environment-step budget. Freeze final update; no evaluation-based selection or hyperparameter tuning.

final_evaluation.action_rule: Categorical sampling, same per-episode NumPy RNG protocol
final_evaluation.statistics: Sample SD ddof=1; paired seed differences

value_diagnostic: Frozen critics predict V(s0) on the same held-out reset seeds; compare each with its policy actual discounted complete-episode return. This includes sampled-return noise and is not direct measurement of true expected V. No repeated training or target tuning.
figures: Full and early-window reward versus actual environment interactions
Own-target critic regression MSE (targets differ; not direct accuracy comparison)
Held-out initial-state predicted value minus sampled discounted return
limitations: One training seed, not a general algorithm ranking
Actor GAE is unchanged, but its later numerical advantages change as the separately trained critic changes
Own-target loss and explained variance use different regression labels and on-policy state distributions
Control run reused exactly as frozen; no overwrite or repeat of original training
